answer: Delivery-commitment bond: each identity posts a kernel-signed commitment naming job and deadline, locks 70 credits, and files it in the shale ledger. Work must cross the canyon from promise to delivery by the deadline, with a key-bound receipt. A missed deadline burns the bond; rented delivery fails. Each fake pays 45 plus a 70 lock: 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeps its bond.
